    margins_name : str, default 'All'

            normalize = axis_subs[normalize]
        except KeyError:
            raise ValueError("Invalid normalize argument")

            raise KeyError(f'Margins name "{margins_name}" is not found in the DataFrame')

    normalizers = {
        "all": lambda x: x / x.sum().sum(),
        "columns": lambda x: x / x.sum(axis=0),
        "index": lambda x: x.div(x.sum(axis=1), axis=0),
    }
